visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a top-down view of a white iPad placed on a light-colored bedspread. A hand holding a white electronic translation pen is positioned over the screen. In the background, a white Stanley-branded tumbler and a book are visible under soft, warm indoor lighting. (2) The hand uses the translation pen to scan across the iPad's screen where a YouTube video is playing with English subtitles. A small blue light emanates from the tip of the pen as it moves. The pen's own small screen displays the scanned text and its Chinese translation in a clean digital interface. (3) The camera provides a close-up shot of the electronic pen's screen. The interface shows detailed vocabulary analysis, including English definitions, Chinese translations, and phonetic symbols. A finger taps on the pen's screen to navigate through the synonyms and example sentences provided by the device's software. (4) The scene transitions to the person using the pen on a physical book with dense English text. The pen moves smoothly over the printed words on the white paper. The background remains the neutral-toned indoor setting with soft lighting. (5) A final graphic overlay appears on the screen, showing various features of the product such as language counts and a LINE app QR code for purchase, set against a colorful, informative background design.
